meta.title: Optimize loops by caching length
meta.body_summary: Optimize loops in Bytes::to_array, Bytes addition, array reversal, and Deque::to_array by caching length() calls in local variables.

perf_labels.notes: OpenAI_Codex cached length() in loops; merged quickly with bot review endorsing the change; no human review or benchmark.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 39 changed lines across 3 files, this is a tiny edit. It fits a small-step, low-risk performance PR and merged smoothly without friction.

review_details.concern_detail: peter-jerry-ye-code-review bot flagged the redundant length() calls and recommended caching (already implemented); also suggested maintainability and correctness improvements.
review_details.performance_claim: Reduce redundant length() calls in loops to lower function call overhead.

core_change_summary.description: In builtin/array.mbt, bytes/bytes.mbt, deque/deque.mbt, cached the result of length() in a local `len` variable before loops to avoid repeated method calls, reducing call overhead.
change_trajectory: Single commit: cached length in array reversal, Bytes::to_array, Bytes addition, and Deque::to_array.
